text:
kai: hey everyone 👋 first day — hitting a few provisioning snags. Tried to sign in with Okta SSO and it offered to migrate to passkeys but the flow errors out with 'Credential already exists for another account'. Also Welcome docs not in My Drive and 1Password invite still pending. who do i poke?

it-support: welcome @kai! that 'Credential already exists' sounds like you previously created a passkey with your personal email (or browser profile). Did you ever register a passkey on this machine before?
kai: i did test a passkey at home but not on this laptop. my work email is kai@redwood.ai but GitHub/old stuff used kai.dev@... Could that be the conflict?
people-ops: we sometimes create a temporary alias during the offer stage (kai.temp@redwood.ai). If your identity got linked to that alias in the identity provider, SCIM/Okta might be mapping differently. @people-ops here — sending you a DM to confirm which email is primary in our system.
security: security note: don't paste any private keys or full attestation blobs here. short logs are fine.
ops-bot: Ticket #ONB-6201 created (category: identity-sync). assignee=it-support. ETA 2 hours.
it-support: quick workaround: open browser passwords/passkeys settings and search for entries for "redwood" or your emails. If you find a passkey tied to kai.dev@, delete it, then retry the Okta passkey migration. If you prefer not to delete, we can rebind the Okta profile to the alias that currently owns the credential.
kai: found an entry in Chrome passkeys for kai.dev@ — removed it and retried. Now Okta migration proceeds but fails at final step with 'SCIM provisioning pending'.
it-support: that means the IdP user exists but SCIM hasn't created your SaaS accounts yet. I'll trigger a manual SCIM push.
people-ops: confirmed your onboarding mapping had the temp alias; I've switched primary to kai@redwood.ai and requeued SCIM sync for 1Password and Drive.
ops-bot: SCIM sync started -> 1Password queue updated.
kai: Drive share appeared under Shared with me, added shortcut. 1Password invite arrived after about 7 minutes and accepted. Passkey migration completed too. Everything green now 🎉
people-ops: welcome aboard @kai! we'll follow up with the onboarding checklist DM. If anyone else hits alias/passkey weirdness, please mention @people-ops so we can correct mappings before SCIM runs.
kai: thanks all — appreciate the quick help!
